description.en: Selection.

Been out of town for 2 weeks and ran out of juice. I'm probably the most picky person when it comes to my vape. I have only used one single flavor since I started about 6 months ago. The guy with the dreadlocks who works at your store made this the best experience at a vape shop hands down. Very informative and quick to let us try out flavors. He was also good at knowing what kind of flavor I was looking for just by describing what I was looking for. If I lived in this area( I live in Kansas), I would most definitely make this store my home for all my vaping needs.
Great shop, best prices in town and best of all everythingnis authentic unlike another shop i went to that sells china clones. Great selection of juice as well.
Very friendly
Nice Place Good prices on juice but the mods are a little on the pricey side

Cool shop had to buy some emergency juice in between my usual online resupplies the guy with the dreads who I think might be named Nick was super helpful he even filled my girlfriends tank up for free, very knowledgeable and willing to help educate customers, that is what a vape shop should be about.
Excellent atmosphere, super kind polite and knowledgeable employees with competitive pricing for their products
Staff is kind and very helpful. Would recommend time and time again over it's competitors.
I have been there once and I didn't feel like a noob. The guy was very helpful and friendly service and I would like to go back again to check out the e-liquids.
Was very helpful and friendly. Had a good experience as a first timer who is getting into vaping with no knowledge of anything. Definitely woulf recommend this place to a friend.

en.text: Hey Donovan, thank you for taking the time to review. We’re glad you enjoyed your first visit to Johnny Vapes!

description.en: These guys very knowledgable in vaping. Offer great discounts, and prices already low. They're friendly and want to earn your business. My advice would be - check them out for yourself, and experience the Johnny Vapes way.

en.text: Mark, thank you for taking the time to leave a rating and for being part of the Johnny Vapes family.

description.en: Friendly and very awesome

I am very pleased with the excellent service these people provide. A big THANK YOU to Josh for helping me fix my vape. It was spitting a lot and I thought it was doomed. Ever since Josh fixed it, it’s been great and hasn’t failed since 5 stars!!!

en.text: Thank you for the review and recognizing Josh.

description.en: The guy working here was friendly and super helpful
Very helpful! I just moved to this area and my mod broke. I googled nearest shops and this is the one that came up. They helped me pick out a new vape and was really helpful.  Thank you
This is my new go to place for anything babe related. The guy Danny there knows his stuff. Excellent selection and good prices an owner who actually knows his stuff. I recommend you check it out

en.text:
Thank you Bobby for taking the time to give a review and write about your experience.
-Johnny Vapes

description.en: I had to stop in for some batteries while visiting from out of town. Excellent little shop. I'm assuming I spoke with Johnny the owner. He was very helpful knowledgeable and polite.
Always top-notch service, tips and tricks from Nick.
I love this vape shop!!! Helpful friendly associates. This is my favorite vape shop by far!!
Great place got what I needed I was in and out.
It was real good experience and the guy was really helpful
Nice place.
Friendly service and variety of products.
Every time I come here the guys are very helpful! Always have answers to my questions and concerns and address things thoroughly. Thanks!
Love the vape juice :)
Nice place. Prety knowledgeable.

Josh was very helpful in the selection process.  Even someone newer to vaping shouldn't hesitate to visit and ask questions.  They had many flavor options to complement their selection of vape devices.
Great customer service.
Best vape shop in town, been a recurring customer for a couple years now.
Fast and friendly and almost always has what I need
Great place always have what I need
Nice and easy going. Shop looks great! Employees are friendly and easy going.

Never had a bad experience the guys who work here are awesome, kind well educated people not to mention he replaced my vape that I told him was leaking for free! Always going to come back no where else
Been going here for years. They know there stuff always ready to help. We love chatting with Josh  !!
Just relocated from Milwaukee & found my new vape shop. They had the Caliburn G coils that I needed in stock & the staff are really chill & helpful
Always super helpful and have a huge collection of juices and supplies.

I had trouble with my new Flytlab and upon returning to the store they replaced it. Twice. The last one he gave me is a wonderful piece of technology. He runs the shop like a wise sage and the customer service is second to none.

Stopped yesterday and Noah was great! Very knowledgeable and patient while I looked for a flavor I liked. It was nice to have someone who was willing to let me take my time to make sure I took home something I’d actually like/use instead of buying one and disliking it and wasting my money. Thanks Noah!

Stopped again yesterday and worked with a different staff member, he was awesome! Very patient with me and didn’t try to upsell me when the flavor I wanted was in a higher level of nicotine than I’m used to. He even cautioned me on increasing the nicotine level and found another flavor in the level I’m used to. These guys are top notch. A manitowoc business that values customers!

Today my caliburn vape stopped working I took it in and the staff took care of it for me my daughter usually goes in for me to get what I need because I'm disabled today I went in with my roommate staff was so great I can't express how much I enjoy going here as it really shows employees enjoy working here and obviously are allowed to do what is needed to keep customers happy there was no I need to call the Boss or corporate love love love this place
Noah was very helpful in helping me choose which products would suit me the best. Very glad I came here! Such friendly people here! I definitely will return! Best vape store I've ever been to!!!
Best vape store in town! If you want the friendliest, most informative employees, and quality vape products - This is the place! (You even get to sample some products before buying)
Ten stars for Owen! Best customer service ever and definitely the best vape shop in town. No need to see any of the “other shops” because Johnny Vapes exists.
Came in today, looking for a coil and left feeling like it was the best experience I have ever had at a vape shop. Most delicious flavors. Owen keeps me coming back.

The owner was so nice and tried to help with the Juice of what he had I picked some up to try it out I hope they change the stupid law this guy is trying to run a business I hope his shelves will soon be filled   Hope they change the laws on the EJUICE I WILL go back.
